_meta.description: Load a saved population and score a cohort against it. Each slot's `populations` entry reads populations/panel_a.pulse-population.json (written by 05_vector_fit_save.json's `save`; the path is relative to the data root and must end .pulse-population.json) under the name panel_a, before any record is read; the name joins the slot's bound-model namespace, so every params.fit and every {population: name} reference resolves it exactly like a Compose vector fit (a name bound twice is PULSE_MODEL_NAME_COLLISION). scored_by_panel: ATTR_MAHALANOBIS `fit: panel_a` gives each respondent's D² from panel a's distribution, and ATTR_PROFILE_SIMILARITY with reference {population: panel_a} the cosine similarity to panel a's mean profile; averaged per panel, panel a's own mean D² is 5.96 (exactly 6 x 149/150, the in-sample identity) and panel b's about 6.59. panel_a_matrix: MAT_CORRELATION `fit: panel_a` emits panel a's correlation matrix from the stored covariance, reading no row; a fit-bound matrix refuses a grouped request (reason fit_grouped), so it sits in its own ungrouped slot. A population fitted on one cohort scores any cohort whose columns its member labels align to (by label, never position); its provenance is reported, never enforced.
_meta.name: compose-population-score
